notes.title: v0.3.6 Open Beta
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

You can now try out the latest update on the beta branch. Check out the full changelist below. 

[b]Important note for this beta[/b]
This beta includes the final phase of the save file consolidation effort (replacing lots of little save files with a few big ones). NPCs and properties now save entirely under a single file, which means saving will be a lot faster, and Steam cloud syncing should finally work properly. In case of any bugs, [u]please be sure to make a backup of your save game before playing it on this beta. [/u] You can use the export/import buttons in the main menu to do this easily. 

For a guide to changing game branches on Steam, see [url=https://youtu.be/xeS7bCwXJ7U?si=ia64_AUeZnWXpAbB]this video[/url].

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added lockers. These will be replacing employee beds. For compatibility reasons, employees will still be assigned to beds in existing saves, but going forward, you can use lockers instead, which are more space-efficient and can store more stuff.
[*]Added item slot filters. You can now set whitelists or blacklists on slots to tell employees which items should or shouldn't go in a particular slot.
[*]Added employee property transfers. 
[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased storage unit employee capacity to 3.
[*]Consolidated all NPC save files.
[*]Consolidated property save files.
[*]Consolidated business save files.
[*]Changed the trash can pickup area to be square instead of circular.
[*]The trash can pickup area is now visible while you're placing the trash can.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed occasional NPC long-distance pathing failures.
[*]Fixed occasional employee pathing failures.
[*]Fixed employees sometimes attempting to pick up items that they don't have the inventory capacity for.
[*]Fixed botanist-related performance issue.
[*]Fixed police showing question marks above their heads while they're unconscious.
[*]Fixed viewmodel drifting.   
[/list]

Let me know how this update goes for you! I think the item slot filters, combined with the lockers, will make employees much more usable now. Saving should also now be much faster and work nicely with Steam cloud sync. 

I'm in the process of setting up an in-game voting system, and will likely run the first vote next week. When it's active, you'll be able to vote on what you want to see in the next major update. The options will probably be:
[list]
[*]Cartel update
[*]Police expansion
[*]Shrooms
[/list]

Stay tuned!
Tyler

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The first content update for Schedule I is here! This update includes a functional [b]pawn shop[/b], [b]boutique store[/b], [b]wall decorations[/b], and more! Check out the full patch list below. Sorry the update is a bit later than expected - I'm still ironing out the update/testing process. Things will be running a lot smoother (and on time) when I do larger monthly updates (starting next month).

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Bleuballs Boutique interior and functionality.

[list]
[*]Improved the counteroffer product selection interface.

[*]Added some extra null checks and validity checks.
[*]Supplier meeting icons in the map app now include the supplier's name.

My next focus will be on taking care of any remaining bugs. My top priorities are:
[list]

[*]Preventing save games getting corrupted/disappearing. I've met with some folks at Valve and got some great insight into how I can improve the save file format so that it plays a bit nicer with Steam Cloud saves, as well as being less prone to corruption. 
[*]Minimizing disconnections and loading issues in multiplayer.
[/list]

I'm also looking into improving optimization. I'd like to get Steam Deck officially supported as soon as possible, so that'll act as my performance benchmark. 

Thanks for reading,
Tyler

notes.title: Post-launch Patch #6 + Alternate Version
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hey everyone, here's the 6th post-launch patch. I've fixed a number of bugs and made a couple of minor tweaks. I've also created what I'm calling the [b]alternate version[/b] of the game for anyone who is experiencing crashes. You can read more below.

[b]Alternate version[/b]
The alternate version is identical to the normal version, except it uses a different [b]scripting backend[/b] (Mono instead of IL2CPP). This scripting backend isn't quite as performant as the normal version, but it generally handles errors a bit better and is less prone to crashing. If you're experiencing consistent crashes in the default version, I'd recommend trying it out. You can opt into the alternate version the same way as switching to the beta version - a video tutorial can be viewed [url=https://youtu.be/xeS7bCwXJ7U?si=ia64_AUeZnWXpAbB]here[/url].

If people find that the alternate version results in fewer crashes, I'll continue to maintain this version and keep it updated to match the default version. Even if the alternate version doesn't fix the crashing, it'll at least send me bug reports with more info compared to the default version.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added alternate version.
[*]Added 'cleartrash' command. Useful if you're experiencing performance drops due to lots of trash items.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Chemists can now be assigned up to 4 stations (up from 3).
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed mixing colliders behind the Slop Shop.
[*]Fixed not being able to knock on the door of the tall building next to the overpass.
[*]Fixed player speed multiplier not resetting after exiting and reloading.
[*]Fixed warehouse NPCs not returning to their jobs after attacking the player.
[*]Fixed employees being able to be assigned to stuff at other properties.
[*]Fixed being able to pick up items while on a skateboard.
[/list]

Thanks for reading,
Tyler

notes.title: v0.2.7: More Effects, Mixing Changes
notes.content:
Hey all,

This week brings 4 new effects - paranoia, sneaky, disorienting, and spicy. I've also reworked the mixing algorithm so that it's a bit more logical and easier to configure and expand upon on my end. A new ingredient has also been added. I've also implemented several improvements to the existing effects.

[h2]Why rework the mixing algorithm?[/h2]
The existing mixing system worked using a bunch of arbitrary numbers, and adding them together to determine if an existing effect can transform into a new effect. It was too random, overcomplicated and didn't feel like it followed any logical rules.

[h2]The new algorithm[/h2]
I've designed the new system to allow me to easily define which effects are similar to other effects (e.g. energizing is similar to athletic, balding to gingeritis, etc) so that mixing operations are a bit more logical. It's still mostly trial and error but should be a bit more predictable.

[h2]Is this going to mess with my existing mixes?[/h2]
No - the new system is set up to preserve any mix recipes you've already created.

If a customer hasn't had a deal for a while, and they've built up a certain level of addiction, they'll come find you and ask for a deal on the spot. You can now approach any of your customers and ask them on the spot if they'd like to make a deal. notes.title: CO-OP Open Beta
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm super excited to be starting an [b]open beta[/b] for CO-OP. Anyone can now opt in to the beta and try out the new multiplayer functionality. Play through Schedule I: Free Sample with up to [b]4 people[/b] at once.

[h2]Opting in[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158368/cd4c27071f9e38506f6913caa90aea070f1554d3.png[/img]
If you'd like to opt in, follow these steps:
[olist]
[*]Right-click Schedule I: Free Sample in your Steam library
[*]Select [b]Properties[/b]
[*]Go to the [b]Betas[/b] tab
[*]Select [b]beta[/b] in the dropdown
[*]Give Steam a minute to switch to the beta branch
[*]All done!
[/olist]
[h2]Inviting friends[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158368/6f62e33c7b487bd2a027ad4cdf4881ca54cfd5ee.png[/img]
To invite friends, press the plus icon in the [b]top right hand corner[/b] of your screen. You can do this in the main menu or the pause screen.

[h2]Important to know[/h2]
This is an open beta - there are likely still major bugs in this version of the game. I'd highly recommend [b]not loading any existing saves[/b]. If you encounter any bugs, I'd really appreciate it if you could report them with the [b]in-game bug reporting tool[/b].

Let me know how you go in multiplayer! Assuming there are no major issues, I'm planning to fully release CO-OP in the coming week.

All the best!
Tyler

Hey everyone,

I hope you're all having fun with the demo! Here's the first post-launch patch - It's mostly bug fixes and small tweaks, but also contains some new voice lines and minor new features. Here's the full list:

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more unique voice lines.
[*]Added a map icon for Albert Hoover's supplier stash.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]Halved mixing station trash.
[*]Applied some filtering to some police chatter SFX.
[*]Slightly reduced main menu music volume.
[*]Additive visuals are now cleared on plant harvest.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Anna Chesterfield missing from customer web.
[*]Fixed missing Anna customer preferences and incorrect deal location.
[*]Fixed body searches being started while under pursuit.
[*]Fixed Sauerkraut Supreme rear colliders blocking door.
[*]Fixed NPCs seeing through some walls.
[*]Fixed baseball bat repeatedly swinging without a proper cooldown.
[*]Fixed product recipe duplication.
[*]Fixed a minor shadow bug in the motel room.
[*]Fixed mixing station completion bug.
[*]Improved soil pourer and sprinkler interaction detection.
[*]Fixed long-life soil applied through soil pourer not persisting after one use.
[*]Fixed vehicle clipping into ground outside Thompson Construction & Demo.
[/list]

I'll likely release another patch or two in the coming week, and then get to work on bigger features after that.

Thanks so much for playing, and stay tuned for more! 
Tyler
